senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עוּן; cmp. עַיִן)spring, fountain; source, issue.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 41b">Ned. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ הנובע</he> a bubbling well, v. <cite ref="B00350"><he>בּוּרְדָּם</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Thazr. 6 <he>כל שער … מ׳ בפני עצמו</he> for each hair … a separate well (which feeds it).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 24:1">Ex. R. s. 24</cite> <he>ברא הקב״ה מ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M02083"><he>מעון</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="C01265"><he>גַּרְגֶּרֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:14">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 2</cite> <he>כבש … מַעְיָינוֹ</he> the Lord held back his germinating issue.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:5">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12:1">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>מ׳ חתום אלו הזכרים</he> ‘a sealed well’ (Cant. l. c.), that means the (pure) males.
<cite ref="Yevamot 64b:19">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ גורם</he> the well (in her womb) is the cause of the death of her successive husbands.

<cite ref="Niddah 11b:10">Nidd. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 35b:55">ib. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ אחד הוא</he> it is one and the same source (from which the menses and the blood at parturition issue); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַעְיָנוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M02107"><he>מַעְיָי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a:13">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כשני מ׳</he> like two springs.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 42:1">Pesik. R. s. 42</cite> <he>יבש כל המ׳ שלו וכ׳</he> he laid dry all the wells (secretory organs) both his own and those of his household &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:3">Tosef. Sot. XV, 3</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ חכמה</he> the well-springs of wisdom.
<cite ref="Niddah 28b:22">Nidd. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מַעְיְנוֹתָיו</he>, <he>מַעְיְנוֹתֶיהָ</he> his, her (the leper’s) discharges; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 81b:16">Snh. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיוקטן מעיינו</he> until his bowels are shrunk.
